description: Taken on strength 1953 with the 26th Air Refueling Squadron at Lockbourne then Westover and Plattsburgh; converted to C-97G in 1958 and later served with the California ANG; to MASDC 8 April 1970 and struck off 16 April 1970; to Foundation for Airborne Relief Long Beach as NX227AR; used in 1975 filming two Mercury Cougar commercials and carries Farrah Fawcett's autograph on the lower fuselage; ferried to Dodgeville Municipal Airport 16 October 1977 and towed off the runway to the Don Q Inn; registered to Quinnco Inc of Dodgeville 19 November 1979 as N227AR and cancelled 7 August 2013; a Wisconsin travel article dated April 2026 confirms a full-sized Boeing C-97 still sits on the property
